---
title: "Mouse scRNA-seq"

---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Read in 14 gene matrices (5x diaphysis, 5x metaphysis and 4x marrow samples - marrow #2 was excluded due to failed capture) from 10X output using Seurat package.
# Combine, QC, assign clusters, find markers and save object.
# Note: due to the amount of data, analysis was run on a High Performance Computer (HPC)

#Load libraries
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(Matrix)
library(cowplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(plyr)

# Read in 10x data contaning barcode and cell ID matrices
Diaphysis_1 <- Read10X(data.dir = "file_location")
Diaphysis_1 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = Diaphysis_1, min.cells = 1, min.features = 50)
Diaphysis_1 <- AddMetaData(Diaphysis_1, metadata="Diaphysis_1", col.name="Sample")

Diaphysis_2 <- Read10X(data.dir = "file_location")
Diaphysis_2 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = Diaphysis_2, min.cells = 1, min.features = 50)
Diaphysis_2 <- AddMetaData(Diaphysis_2, metadata="Diaphysis_2", col.name="Sample")

Diaphysis_3 <- Read10X(data.dir = "file_location")
Diaphysis_3 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = Diaphysis_3, min.cells = 1, min.features = 50)
Diaphysis_3 <- AddMetaData(Diaphysis_3, metadata="Diaphysis_3", col.name="Sample")

Diaphysis_4 <- Read10X(data.dir = "file_location")
Diaphysis_4 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = Diaphysis_4, min.cells = 1, min.features = 50)
Diaphysis_4 <- AddMetaData(Diaphysis_4, metadata="Diaphysis_4", col.name="Sample")

Diaphysis_5 <- Read10X(data.dir = "file_location")
Diaphysis_5 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = Diaphysis_5, min.cells = 1, min.features = 50)
Diaphysis_5 <- AddMetaData(Diaphysis_5, metadata="Diaphysis_5", col.name="Sample")

Metaphysis_1 <- Read10X(data.dir = "file_location")
Metaphysis_1 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = Metaphysis_1, min.cells = 1, min.features = 50)
Metaphysis_1 <- AddMetaData(Metaphysis_1, metadata="Metaphysis_1", col.name="Sample")

Metaphysis_2 <- Read10X(data.dir = "file_location")
Metaphysis_2 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = Metaphysis_2, min.cells = 1, min.features = 50)
Metaphysis_2 <- AddMetaData(Metaphysis_2, metadata="Metaphysis_2", col.name="Sample")

Metaphysis_3 <- Read10X(data.dir = "file_location")
Metaphysis_3 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = Metaphysis_3, min.cells = 1, min.features = 50)
Metaphysis_3 <- AddMetaData(Metaphysis_3, metadata="Metaphysis_3", col.name="Sample")

Metaphysis_4 <- Read10X(data.dir = "file_location")
Metaphysis_4 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = Metaphysis_4, min.cells = 1, min.features = 50)
Metaphysis_4 <- AddMetaData(Metaphysis_4, metadata="Metaphysis_4", col.name="Sample")

Metaphysis_5 <- Read10X(data.dir = "file_location")
Metaphysis_5 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = Metaphysis_5, min.cells = 1, min.features = 50)
Metaphysis_5 <- AddMetaData(Metaphysis_5, metadata="Metaphysis_5", col.name="Sample")

Marrow_1 <- Read10X(data.dir = "file_location")
Marrow_1 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = Marrow_1, min.cells = 1, min.features = 50)
Marrow_1 <- AddMetaData(Marrow_1, metadata="Marrow_1", col.name="Sample")

Marrow_3 <- Read10X(data.dir = "file_location")
Marrow_3 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = Marrow_3, min.cells = 1, min.features = 50)
Marrow_3 <- AddMetaData(Marrow_3, metadata="Marrow_3", col.name="Sample")

Marrow_4 <- Read10X(data.dir = "file_location")
Marrow_4 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = Marrow_4, min.cells = 1, min.features = 50)
Marrow_4 <- AddMetaData(Marrow_4, metadata="Marrow_4", col.name="Sample")

Marrow_5 <- Read10X(data.dir = "file_location")
Marrow_5 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = Marrow_5, min.cells = 1, min.features = 50)
Marrow_5 <- AddMetaData(Marrow_5, metadata="Marrow_5", col.name="Sample")

#Merge 
samples_merged <- merge(Diaphysis_1, y = c(Diaphysis_2, Diaphysis_3, Diaphysis_4, Diaphysis_5, Metaphysis_1, Metaphysis_2, Metaphysis_3, Metaphysis_4, Metaphysis_5, Marrow_1, Marrow_3, Marrow_4, Marrow_5))

# Mitochondria Genes and number of genes QC
samples_merged[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(samples_merged, pattern = "^mt-")

VlnPlot(samples_merged, features = c("nFeature_RNA"), pt.size = 0.01, y.max = NULL, split.by = "Sample") 

VlnPlot(samples_merged, features = c("percent.mt"), pt.size = 0.01, y.max = NULL, split.by = "Sample") 

#Filter based on nFeature 100, very low threshold as many CD45neg cells h
samples_merged <- subset(samples_merged, subset = nFeature_RNA > 300)
samples_merged <- subset(samples_merged, subset = percent.mt < 20)

#Normalise data
samples_merged <- NormalizeData(samples_merged, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

#Find variable features
samples_merged <- FindVariableGenes(object = samples_merged, mean.function = ExpMean, dispersion.function = LogVMR,
                           x.low.cutoff = 0.0125, x.high.cutoff = 3, y.cutoff = 0.5)
#Scale data
all.genes <- rownames(samples_merged)
samples_merged <- ScaleData(samples_merged, features = all.genes)

#Linear dimensional reduction
samples_merged <- RunPCA(samples_merged, features = VariableFeatures(object = samples_merged))

#Clustering and UMAP
samples_merged <- FindClusters(object = samples_merged, reduction.type = "pca", dims.use = 1:40,
                                          resolution = 1, print.output = 0, save.SNN = TRUE)

samples_merged <- RunUMAP(samples_merged, dims = 1:40)

pdf("plots/umap_resolution_1.pdf", width = 10, height = 10)
DimPlot(samples_merged, group.by = "RNA_snn_res.1", pt.size = 0.01, label = T, raster = F)
dev.off()

#Find all markers 
markers <- FindAllMarkers(object = samples_merged, logfc.threshold = 0.5, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25)

#save object
save(samples_merged, file = "Seurat_object/samples_merged.Robj")



```
